subject: Re: SummitBridge — trace & prompt adaptor kickoff
messages:
From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@summitbridge.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Patel <samira.patel@summitbridge.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SummitBridge — trace & prompt adaptor kickoff

Hi Sean / Vanessa,

Thanks again for taking time today. As discussed, SummitBridge is interested in building a first-party adaptor that allows our enterprise customers to route tracing and prompt-level telemetry from their LangChain/LlamaIndex workflows into Redwood's tracing pipeline. Our primary asks for the pilot are:

- Lightweight SDK shims for LangChain Agents (Python) and LlamaIndex (Node)
- A standardized trace envelope that includes prompt templates, model variant, token counts, and upstream request IDs
- Minimal latency overhead (target <5ms per call) and opt-in privacy/PII redaction hooks

We've attached a short integration spec and a prototype trace schema. We'd like to kick off a technical sync next week to align on API shapes and rollout milestones. Proposed slots: Tue 2027-08-17 10:00 PT or Wed 2027-08-18 09:00 PT.

Best,
Alex
VP Partnerships, SummitBridge
attachments: summitbridge-integration-specs-v1.pdf (pdf), prototype-trace-schema.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@summitbridge.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SummitBridge — trace & prompt adaptor kickoff

Alex — thanks for the clear doc. 

Jonas (runtime/telemetry) and Vanessa (partner ops) are looped in — I'll own the project tie-breaks from commercial/sales side. Tue 10:00 PT works for us.

A few quick asks before the sync so we can come prepared:
- Can you share a small sample trace event (example JSON) showing fields you expect from both LangChain and LlamaIndex flows?
- Which LangChain versions and LlamaIndex bindings do you expect to support for the initial pilot?
- Are you planning a hosted SDK (SummitBridge-maintained) or a joint SDK that calls Redwood endpoints?

We'll review the spec and come with a proposed acceptance checklist (SLA/latency targets, telemetry retention, and redaction knobs).

See you Tue.
Sean
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
phone: +1 (415) 555-0194

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@summitbridge.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-17T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SummitBridge — trace & prompt adaptor kickoff

Great sync this morning — notes and next steps: 

Summary:
- Agreed on a minimal trace envelope: request_id, timestamp, model_name, model_variant, prompt_template_id, prompt_text_snippet (first 256 chars), tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, error_code (if any), redaction_flag
- LangChain shim will emit an event per agent action (tool call, model call). LlamaIndex shim will emit per-query events and indexed-chunk references.
- Opt-in PII redaction: we will implement a pluggable redaction callback that SummitBridge can host or use Redwood's default.

Action items (owners / ETA):
1) SummitBridge: provide sample JSON events for both LangChain (Py) and LlamaIndex (Node) — due 2027-08-18 EOD — Alex (owner)
2) Redwood runtime: prototype a lightweight ingestion endpoint and a schema validation layer — due 2027-08-20 — Jonas (owner)
3) Security/compliance: Vanessa to initiate a short scoping doc for retention and encryption (KMS) — due 2027-08-19 — Vanessa (owner)
4) Engineering: agree on telemetry naming conventions and decide whether to reuse existing event names (recommended) — joint discussion 2027-08-20 sync

I've dropped a PR boilerplate on your repo (link shared after this thread) and attached the prototype trace schema we iterated on.

Jonas
Senior Engineer, Runtime Telemetry
attachments: prototype-trace-schema.xlsx

From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@summitbridge.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Patel <samira.patel@summitbridge.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-18T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SummitBridge — trace & prompt adaptor kickoff

Thanks Jonas — attaching two sample events (LangChain and LlamaIndex) inline and in Drive link. High-level notes:
- LangChain sample comes from an Agent flow that uses a tools pipeline — you will see tool_call events with references to tool_name and tool_response_time_ms.
- LlamaIndex sample is from a semantic retrieval + re-rank step — includes chunk_ids and retrieval_scores.

We prefer the SummitBridge-managed shim initially (keeps rollout independent), but we need a low-lift option for customers who want Redwood-hosted ingestion. We'll include a toggle in the shim.

Alex

Following up on open items — quick status update for the runbook and commercial sync next week:

- Security scoping: initial KMS footprint and retention policy draft (30/90/365 day tiers) is ready — I'm attaching the short scoping slide. We need SummitBridge to confirm which retention tiers they will want for pilot customers.
- Runtime ingestion: Jonas has a prototype ingestion endpoint standing up on staging. Sample validation errors returned for missing prompt_template_id — Jonas to follow up with field-level guidance.
- Commercial: Sean, we should propose a simple pilot MOU for a 90-day technical pilot (no revenue) with an optional opt-in commercial integration afterwards. If OK, I'll draft and send to Alex next week.

Next steps for Alex / SummitBridge: confirm retention tiers + send final sample events by EOD 2027-08-21.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
